description: We are Left Behind Stars - a team of 3 girls from Khujand, Tajikistan! Our challenge is “Abandoned but not forgotten “. We want to tell stories of abandoned spacecraft-like Oppy, the little Mars rover who was left alone but never forgotten. We love story telling,design and websites.We believe every forgotten machine still has an echo to send to Earth.
summary: Our project is a comic called “Left Behind Stars”. It tells the true stories of three abandoned space robots: Opportunity, Voyager and Philae. Each robot speaks in first person and shares its journey, its loneliness, and its hope to be remembered. Through fun and emotional storytelling , we show that even forgotten machines still matter. Our comic turns real NASA history into history into art that connects people to space. It is important because it reminds us to remember those who explored space for us.
details:
Our project “Left Behind Stars“is a digital comic made in Canva . It works as a storybook: the reader opens the link and reads 3 chapters about Opportunity, Voyager and Philae. Each robot tells its own story in first person. Opportunity says:” Hi! I’m Opportunity ! I lived on Mars for 15 years! I was supposed to work only 90 days but I stayed for 15 years! I am a small but I‘m strong!” Voyager talks about flying alone in space for 47 year. Philae talks about landing on a comet and falling asleep.

The benefit is emotional learning. People especially children, learn real NASA history not from boring facts, but from feelings. They start to care about space.

We used Canva for design and drawing, Google for research about NASA missions, and Meta AI for help with English text . Our creativity is that we gave voice to forgotten machines. We thought about making it simple, kind and easy to read for everyone.

Our project shows that even if a robot is left behind, its story still matters.
